clinical_bronchiolitis_score_value_recor.assessment: The chart provides no bronchiolitis score or enough detailed findings to calculate it; so the value must be deferred to screening.

patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_months.assessment: The child is described as a 4 year old boy; 4 years is 48 months.
patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_months.evidence: A 4 year old boy presents to the emergency room with wheezing.

patient_has_finding_of_bronchiolitis_now.assessment: Although the child has wheezing and cough, the presentation is sudden onset after playing outside, suggestive of foreign body aspiration, and not the typical clinical picture for bronchiolitis; thus, not supported.
patient_has_finding_of_bronchiolitis_now.evidence: she heard him suddenly start coughing. The coughing lasted only moments, but he has been audibly wheezing since.

patient_has_finding_of_bronchiolitis_now.assessment: The chart does not document the full bronchiolitis syndrome (tachypnea, cough, prolonged expiratory phase, rales, retractions, hyperinflation); sudden cough and isolated wheeze point away from this.
patient_has_finding_of_bronchiolitis_now.evidence: on exam...Wheezing is heard in the mid-right chest area.

patient_has_finding_of_chest_retractions.assessment: There is no documentation of chest retractions.

patient_has_finding_of_cough_now.assessment: Mother reports sudden onset of coughing moments before persistent wheezing, supporting a current cough.
patient_has_finding_of_cough_now.evidence: she heard him suddenly start coughing. The coughing lasted only moments, but he has been audibly wheezing since.

patient_has_finding_of_hyperinflation_of.assessment: No chest radiograph findings are described in the chart.

patient_has_finding_of_prolonged_expirat.assessment: Chart is silent on prolonged expiratory phase; per prescreen doctrine, inclusion-side silence defaults to NULL.

patient_has_finding_of_rales_now.assessment: No mention of rales on physical exam; inclusion-side silence defaults to NULL.

patient_has_finding_of_respiratory_syncy.assessment: No mention of RSV diagnosis or testing; inclusion-side silence defaults to NULL.

patient_has_finding_of_tachypnea_now.assessment: The chart does not describe tachypnea (no mention of rapid breathing or abnormal respiratory rate); inclusion-side silence defaults to NULL.

patient_has_finding_of_wheezing_now.assessment: Physical exam states 'wheezing is heard in the mid-right chest area', supporting current wheezing.
patient_has_finding_of_wheezing_now.evidence: Wheezing is heard in the mid-right chest area.
